front:
CAMERA FIRST: SOUTH FRONT elevation looking NORTH. The final TOP defines north-up/east-right positions; south is near camera. Moderate front elevation with vertical cliff faces and full underside, not another overhead image.
Image1 is the existing FRONT draft: preserve its landmass, camera orientation, materials and world identity. Image2 is the NEW FINAL TOP: update the road to its CLOSED winding itinerary and add the SAME new tech buildings seen there. Replace old open road completely. Do not simply copy the unchanged draft.
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE complete 3D environment modeling asset view, premium crafted stylized materials, same biome world. Whole island and underside/trees/building tips/waterfall bottoms visible with12%margin, neutral pale-grey studio background, no horizon/ocean/fog hiding geometry.
Physical route MUST follow the NEW closed guide: a long SERPENTINE CIRCUIT passing through the INTERIOR with many alternating smooth bends, then a return corridor JOINING the start tangentially. One continuous repeatable road, NO DEAD ENDS and NO ordinary round perimeter racetrack. Keep the winding interior parts dominant. No same-level intersections, shortcuts, disconnected segments or sharp junction. Reserve generous clear shoulders on both sides for later musical tiles. No labels, marker dots, arrows, compass, UI, characters or glowing tile chain.
TRIPO GEOMETRY: OPEN RAVINES and visible cuttings. NO enclosed caves or long tunnels, no dark tunnel mouth. Only a very SHORT thick natural stone ARCH like a small stone bridge, open to daylight on BOTH sides, with clearly visible road continuing through; roof length no more than road width. Broad flat bridge decks with smooth bank connections. No stairs, house entrances, machines or vegetation across the road.
Add the specified courier-world buildings OUTSIDE road shoulders on broad raised pads. Rounded functional doors, chunky brass/copper radio vents, short sturdy antennas and visible simple mechanisms match the courier characters. Buildings use each world's OWN materials/palette; do not recolor all worlds cream/mint. Keep main terrain silhouette, biome landmarks and distinct colors from draft. Avoid huge central tower surrounded by a circle. Few large readable structures and coherent landscape, not tiny crowded scatter.

WORLD: Грозовой берег
PALETTE: Navy and storm grey, nearly black basalt, blue-green inlet water, weathered brown wood and rusty red nautical accents. No warm ivory garden.
TERRAIN: A low long jagged coastline slab with a diagonal sheltered inlet cutting deeply into the interior, uneven black basalt headlands connected by broad inland land corridors.
LANDSCAPE: A short off-center rust-red semaphore mast with thick paddles, low timber rain shelter, sheltered inlet and heavy basalt arch. One small pond with rain ripple relief; no airborne rain streaks or mist hiding geometry.
COURIER ARCHITECTURE: Two low weatherproof radio homes embedded in NORTHWEST basalt headland; NORTHEAST shelter deck becomes a timber/navy-steel radio depot with chunky roof antenna and heavy brass exhaust. One squat rust-red signal/windmill tower on SOUTHEAST rock buttress, thick paddle arms instead of a fine lattice mast. Damp timber, navy roofs and rusty brass.
ROAD MATERIAL: Wide rough slate coastal road changing to thick brown timber decking near the shelter, grey gravel shoulders.
ART DIRECTION: Bold nautical silhouettes, simplified weathered basalt and damp material sheen, cool overcast material lighting.
